subject.title: feat(dashboard): persist MCP Apps as board widgets

question: Should OpenClaw accept this backend-only durable MCP App widget contract now, including its persisted descriptor format and `board.widget.appView` RPC, before a user-facing dashboard flow consumes it?
rationale: The patch adds a new persisted board-content capability and Gateway protocol surface; tests can validate mechanics, but they cannot decide the intended rollout and long-term contract boundary.

options.title: Accept the backend phase
options.body: Confirm the durable descriptor, reminting, and authorization model as the dashboard program’s supported contract, contingent on explicit upgrade and revocation scenario evidence.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Keep the PR open but reduce or redesign the persistence/RPC surface before committing it as a supported board capability.

options.title: Defer to the UI phase
options.body: Pause the backend addition until a dashboard UI consumer and end-to-end product flow are ready to establish the complete contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the backend phase
recommendation.body: Confirm the durable descriptor, reminting, and authorization model as the dashboard program’s supported contract, contingent on explicit upgrade and revocation scenario evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged dashboard foundation and its follow-on program scope are the closest available ownership evidence.
